note: Realism audit 1.2.3 (docs/realism-audit-1.2.3/questions.md): 623 fresh player lines, written before reading the bench, with kind (question, statement, followup), level bracket, data_gap (the repo cannot give the true answer yet) and variant_of (the same line in another channel). #477 tightened the must_any patterns the hand judgments showed loose (or too strict); those carry "tightened". make_player_questions.py takes the ids of audit/proposal.json from here: "bench" into player_questions.json, "holdout" into player_questions_holdout.json; "needs_owner_fact" waits for facts from the world database.
